_evidence: 0x00443148 (compose AFTER the 0x004097c7 chain layouts): with al == 0 it loops 'call 0x401462; and eax,0x3f; cmp eax,[0x66d8ec]; jge 0x44314c', so the car-list count dword [0x66d8ec] must be >= 1 (with 0 no index 0..63 is below it and the loop never ends); it is the number of entries of the 22-byte car-code list 0x66d8f4..0x66d909 (list_00443278/order_00675958: at most 22 cars), drawn 1..22. A simulation of the 0x401462 byte generator (40-bit linear shift register) from 3000 random states reached an index below the count within 600 draws for count 1 (26 for 22), so every case terminates. The accepted index 0..count-1 then reads 'mov cl,[eax+0x66d8f4]' (inside the 22 list bytes) and passes it to 0x004097c7 as the key al; 0x4097c7 was accepted with eax any u32, so any byte is valid: car codes 1..22 plus 0, 0x3f, bit-6/bit-7 flagged codes. Byte [0x7c2ea9] 'cmp 0x44; je 0x44318c' (skips the store of the random word to 0x66d8c4) draws 0x44 in a third of the cases and the values the chain layouts use otherwise (0x80, 0, 0x7f, 0xff; state_004059ef shows the chain handles 0x44 without faults). Compares and reads only.
